reference.title: Scenario 2 — Two-level nested bullet list
reference.shortdesc: Consider a <ul> list with a second tier of nested <ul> sub-items beneath selected parent

section.p: Consider a <ul> list with a second tier of nested <ul> sub-items beneath selected parent <li> items.

entry.codeblock:
System Requirements

  • Supported platforms
    • Windows 10 and later
    • macOS 12 and later
  • Prerequisites
    • 8 GB RAM minimum
    • 20 GB free disk space

System Requirements
  • Supported platforms
    • Windows 10 and later
    • macOS 12 and later
  • Prerequisites

section.p: Result: Nested <ul> elements are preserved when native HTML list nesting is applied correctly. Each nested <ul> is placed inside its parent <li> element in the DITA output.
section.note:
Never simulate indentation using   characters or CSS padding inside a

element — this does not create a nested list structure and the converter does not recognize it as such.
